theorem bounded_radial_count (A : ℝ) {I : Set ℝ} (hI : Bornology.IsBounded I) :
    ∃ C > 0, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ Z T : ℝ,
      (relevantLabels n A (radialSlice I Z T)).Finite ∧
        ((relevantLabels n A (radialSlice I Z T)).ncard : ℝ) ≤ C * ChartScales.S n ^ 3
